notes: Red Moose lists a TARVAS .308 Win hunting cartridge. Ammobilen lists a GGG .308 165 gr BT TARVAS load at 825 m/s with G1 BC 0.301. Its bullet matches Tarvas material T300165-1 by caliber and weight. The Tarvas cartridge's test-barrel length is not published; the bullet selection page gives a 500 m/s minimum impact speed for opening in tissue with high water content.

Material T264130-1. Tarvas lists a 6.70 mm diameter, 8.4 g / 130 gr mass, 32.8 mm length and G1 BC 0.300. Its selection page gives a minimum twist of 8.7 in and says all bullets open at impact speeds of 500 m/s or more in tissue with high water content.
